text:
The Activity:

Both people should do the activity.
  1. Decide which book you think is the best book ever. You can talk together or think on your own.
  2. Think of some reasons that it is the best book ever. If you want, you could make some notes to help you remember your ideas. Here are some things you could think about:
    • What did you enjoy about it?
    • Do other people like it?
    • Is there anything you can learn from it?
    • What is important about this book?
    • Are there any other books like it?
    • Why is it better than the other books you talked about in the warmup?
  3. Explain to the other person why your book is the best book ever.
  4. Listen to what the other person has to say.
  5. Talk together about why you agreed or disagreed on the best book. Is it possible for there to be only one best book?

Warmup:

Can you think of any really good books? Make a short list together and talk about what you think makes them really good.
